items.item_text: What is the Adoption Date of the document?
items.answer: Effective July 1, 1997; Restatement Dated July 20, 2001 And Executed November 21, 2002.

references.excerpt: Effective July 1, 1997; Dated July 20, 2001.

items.item_text: What is the Plan Anniversary?
items.answer: July 1 Plan Year.

references.excerpt: The Plan Year Is The 12-Month Period Beginning July 1 And Ending June 30.

items.item_text: What are the groups of employees covered under the plan?
items.answer: All Employee Classifications Except Faculty, Administrative Staff, Self-Employed Individuals, Temporary Employees, Students, And Leased Employees.

references.excerpt: The Plan Covers All Employee Classifications Except Faculty, Administrative Staff, Self-Employed Individuals, Temporary Employees, Students, And Leased Employees.

items.item_text: What are the participation eligibility requirements in the plan?
items.answer: Age 21 And 1 Year Of Eligibility Service.

references.excerpt: Eligible To Participate... On The Entry Date... After Attainment Of Age 21 And Completion Of 1 Year Of Eligibility Service.

items.item_text: What is the participation date after attainment of eligibility in the plan?
items.answer: Earlier January 1 Or July 1 Coincident With Or Next Following The Date Eligibility Requirements Are Met.

references.excerpt: Entry Date Means The Earlier Of The January 1 Or July 1 Which Coincides With Or Next Follows The Date Upon Which The Eligibility Requirements Are Met.

items.item_text: What is the Age/Service retirement eligibility for normal retirement in the plan?
items.answer: Age 65.

references.excerpt: Normal Retirement Age... Attainment Of Age 65.

items.item_text: What is the Start Date for normal retirement in the plan?
items.answer: First Day Of The Month Coincident With Or Next Following Attainment Of Normal Retirement Age.

references.excerpt: Normal Retirement Date Is The First Day Of The Month Which Coincides With Or Next Follows The Date On Which The Participant Attains Normal Retirement Age.

items.item_text: What is the Age/Service retirement eligibility for Early Unreduced benefit retirement in the plan?
items.answer: N/A

items.item_text: What is the Age/Service retirement eligibility for Early Reduced benefit retirement in the plan?
items.answer: Age 55 And 10 Years Of Vesting Service After Termination.

references.excerpt: Termination Of Employment After Attainment Of Age 55 And Completion Of 10 Years Of Vesting Service.

items.item_text: What is the Start Date for early retirement in the plan?
items.answer: First Day Of The Month Coincident With Or Next Following Satisfaction Of Early Retirement Requirements Selected By Participant.

references.excerpt: Early Retirement Date... First Day Of The Month Which Coincides With Or Next Follows The Date Upon Which He Satisfies The Following Requirements.

items.item_text: For Deferred vested, not eligible to retire as of date of termination, what is the Age/Service retirement eligibility for normal retirement in the plan?
items.answer: Normal Retirement Age 65; Vested Terminated Participant Receives Vested Accrued Benefit At Normal Retirement Date.

references.excerpt: Participant Will Become Entitled To Receive A Normal Retirement Benefit Commencing On His Normal Retirement Date Equal To His Vested Accrued Benefit.

items.item_text: For Deferred vested, not eligible to retire as of date of termination, what is the Age/Service retirement eligibility for early retirement in the plan?
items.answer: Vested Terminated Participant May Commence After Satisfying Early Retirement; If Service Met But Not Age, Benefit Available Upon Later Age 55.

references.excerpt: If The Participant Has Satisfied The Service Requirement But Not The Age Requirement For Early Retirement, He Will Be Entitled... Upon Later Satisfaction Of The Age Requirement.

items.item_text: What is the retirement eligibility for late retirement in the plan?
items.answer: Late Retirement Applies If Employee Continues Or Is Reemployed After Normal Retirement Date; Benefit Begins At Retirement/Resumed Retirement Or Required Beginning Date.

references.excerpt: If A Participant Continues As An Employee Or Is Re-Employed After His Normal Retirement Date...

items.item_text: What is the eligibility requirement for disability under the plan?
items.answer: Disability Retirement Requires Severance Due To Disability, 10 Years Of Vesting Service, Eligibility For Social Security Disability, And Permanent Disability Conditions.

references.excerpt: Disability Retirement Date... Provided The Participant Has Completed Ten (10) Or More Years Of Vesting Service.

items.item_text: How the plan defines Eligibility/Participation service?
items.answer: Eligibility Service Uses The Elapsed Time Method; A Year Is Each Completed 12 Months Of Elapsed Time.

references.excerpt: Years Of Service Are Determined Using The Elapsed Time Method And The Hours Of Service Method.

items.item_text: How the plan defines vesting service?
items.answer: Vesting Service Uses The Elapsed Time Method And Counts All Years Of Vesting Service.

references.excerpt: Years Of Service For Purposes Of Computing A Participant's Vested Percentage Are Referred To As Years Of Vesting Service And Are Determined Using The Elapsed Time Method.

items.item_text: How the plan defines benefit service?
items.answer: Benefit Service Generally Counts Service While In Eligible Classification, Excluding Waived Participation, Ineligible Classification, Related Employer Nonparticipation, And Uncompensated Service.

references.excerpt: Years Of Benefit Service... Except Service While The Employee Declined Participation... Was Not In An Eligible Employee Classification...

items.item_text: Does the plan defines other type of service besides eligibility/participation, vesting and benefit service?
items.answer: Qualified Military Service Is Credited Under IRC §414(u); Leave Of Absence May Protect Reemployment Rights.

references.excerpt: Qualified Military Service... Contributions, Benefits And Service Credit... In Accordance With Code Section 414(u).

items.item_text: What is the accrued benefit formula under the plan?
items.answer: Monthly Normal Retirement Benefit Equals 1/12 Of 1% Of Average Annual Compensation Times Years Of Benefit Service.

references.excerpt: 1/12th Of... 1% Of Average Annual Compensation, Multiplied By Years Of Benefit Service.

items.item_text: What is the Accrual factor in the accrued benefit formula?
items.answer: 1% Of Average Annual Compensation Times Years Of Benefit Service, Payable Monthly As 1/12 Of Annual Amount.

references.excerpt: 1% Of Average Annual Compensation, Multiplied By Years Of Benefit Service.

items.item_text: What is the Short service factor in the accrued benefit formula?
items.answer: N/A

items.item_text: What compensation is used in the accrued benefit formula?
items.answer: Form W-2 Wages, Tips And Other Compensation, Excluding Reimbursements, Fringe Benefits, Moving Expenses, Deferred Compensation And Welfare Benefits, Plus Certain Salary Reduction Amounts.

references.excerpt: Compensation Shall Mean... Wages, Tips And Other Compensation As Reported On Form W-2.

items.item_text: How the plan defines average compensation to use in the accrued benefit formula?
items.answer: Average Annual Compensation Equals Total Compensation During Last 60 Months Of Service Divided By 5; If Less Than 60 Months, Based On Actual Months.

references.excerpt: Average Annual Compensation Is Determined By Dividing The Total Compensation... During The Last Sixty (60) Months Of Service By 5.

items.item_text: What is the Covered Compensation for Integrated Plans?
items.answer: N/A

items.item_text: What is the Primary Insurance Amount (PIA) Offset in the plan?
items.answer: N/A

items.item_text: If the plan is a Cash-Balance plan, What is the Initial Account Balance in the plan?
items.answer: N/A

items.item_text: If the plan is a Cash-Balance plan, How the the plan defines Benefit Credit in the Cash Balance Account?
items.answer: N/A

items.item_text: If the plan is a Cash-Balance plan, How the the plan defines Interest Credit in the Cash Balance Account?
items.answer: N/A

items.item_text: If the plan is a Cash-Balance plan, What is the Timing of Interest Credit in the Cash Balance Account?
items.answer: N/A

items.item_text: If the plan is a Cash-Balance plan, What is the Annuity Conversion Factor in the Cash Balance Account?
items.answer: N/A

items.item_text: If the plan is a Cash-Balance plan, What is the Annuity Conversion Method in the Cash Balance Account?
items.answer: N/A

items.item_text: If there are Supplemental Benefits in the plan, What is the eligibility for those?
items.answer: N/A

items.item_text: If there are Supplemental Benefits in the plan, What is the amount?
items.answer: N/A

items.item_text: If there are Supplemental Benefits in the plan, What is the Duration?
items.answer: N/A

items.item_text: What is the Normal Single Form of benefit as defined in the plan?
items.answer: Unmarried Participants Receive A Qualified Life Annuity Unless Electing The Normal Benefit Form Or Optional Form; Normal Benefit Form Is Lifetime Pension, 3 Years Certain.

references.excerpt: A Participant Who Is Not Married... Will Be Provided A Qualified Life Annuity Unless He Elects...

items.item_text: What is the Normal Married Form of benefit as defined in the plan?
items.answer: Married Participants Receive A Qualified Joint And Survivor Annuity Unless A Qualified Election Is Made.

references.excerpt: A Participant Who Is Married... Will Be Provided A Qualified Joint And Survivor Annuity Unless He Makes A Qualified Election.

items.item_text: What is the Basis for Form Conversion Factors as defined in the plan?
items.answer: 8% Annual Interest And UP-1984 Mortality For General Actuarial Equivalence; Lump Sums Use Applicable Interest Rate And Applicable Mortality Table Under §417(e).

references.excerpt: Interest: 8% Per Annum, Compounded Annually; Mortality: UP-1984 Mortality Table.

items.item_text: How the plan calculates the Early Retirement Adjustment?
items.answer: Reduced By 1/180 For Each Of First 60 Months And 1/360 For Each Of Next 60 Months Early Before Normal Retirement Date.

references.excerpt: Reduced By 1/180 For Each Of The First 60 Months And By 1/360 For Each Of The Next 60 Months.

items.item_text: How the plan calculates the Late Retirement Adjustment?
items.answer: Late Benefit Is Greater Of Actuarial Equivalent Of Normal Benefit At Normal Retirement Date Or Formula Benefit Through Late Retirement, Reduced By Earlier Payments; Special Rule After Age 70½.

references.excerpt: Late Retirement Benefit Will Be Equal To The Greater Of...

items.item_text: What are, if any, the Suspension of Benefit Provisions?
items.answer: Benefits Suspended During Reemployment Months With ERISA §203(a)(3)(B) Service, Subject To Notice And Regulatory Rules.

references.excerpt: Payment... Shall Be Suspended For Each Calendar Month During Which The Participant Completes ERISA Section 203(a)(3)(b) Service.

items.item_text: What are, if any, the Disability Benefit Provisions?
items.answer: Disability Benefit Equals Actuarial Equivalent Of Accrued Benefit As Of Disability Retirement Date; Nonforfeitable Except Death Or Recovery.

references.excerpt: Disability Retirement Benefit Is Equal To The Monthly Retirement Benefit... Actuarial Equivalent Of The Participant's Accrued Benefit.

items.item_text: What are, if any, the Pre-Retirement Death Benefits?
items.answer: Before Annuity Starting Date, Married Vested Participant's Surviving Spouse Or Beneficiary Receives Qualified Survivor Annuity; Unmarried Beneficiary Receives 50% Contingent Survivor Pension.

references.excerpt: A Participant's Beneficiary Will Be Entitled To Receive A Death Benefit If The Participant Dies Before His Annuity Starting Date.

items.item_text: What are, if any, the Post-Retirement Death Benefits?
items.answer: After Retirement, Death Benefit Is Paid According To The Form Of Benefit Payment Elected Under The Plan.

references.excerpt: In The Event Of Death Of A Retired Participant, A Benefit Will Be Paid... In Accordance With The Form Of Benefit Payment Elected.

items.item_text: What is the Vesting Schedule included in the Provisions for Deferred Participants?
items.answer: Less Than 3 Years 0%; 3 20%; 4 40%; 5 60%; 6 80%; 7 Or More 100%; Top-Heavy Alternative Less Than 2 0%, 2 20%, 3 40%, 4 60%, 5 80%, 6 Or More 100%.

references.excerpt: Vesting Schedule... Less Than 3 Years 0%, 3 Years 20%, 4 Years 40%, 5 Years 60%, 6 Years 80%, 7 Years Or More 100%.

items.item_text: What is the Cash-out Provisions included in the Provisions for Deferred Participants?
items.answer: If Present Value Does Not Exceed $5,000, Immediate Distribution; If Greater Than $5,000, Lump Sum Requires Participant And Spousal Consent Within Stated Period.

references.excerpt: If The Present Value... Does Not Exceed $5,000... Immediate Distribution.

items.item_text: What is the One-Year Break In Service included in the Provisions for Deferred Participants?
items.answer: One Year Break-In-Service Means Any Plan Year With 500 Or Fewer Hours Of Service; Zero-Vested Participant Loses Prior Service After 5 Consecutive Breaks.

references.excerpt: One Year Break-In-Service Means Any Plan Year During Which The Employee Completes 500 Or Fewer Hours Of Service.

items.item_text: What are the Transfer Provisions defined in the plan?
items.answer: Plan Merger, Consolidation, Or Transfer Permitted Only If Each Participant Receives A Benefit Immediately After At Least Equal To Pre-Transaction Benefit.

references.excerpt: Each Participant... Would Receive A Benefit Immediately After The Merger... Equal To Or Greater Than The Benefit... Immediately Before.

items.item_text: If the plan has Mandatory Employee Contributions (EEC), How the plan defines its Contributions?
items.answer: No Participant Contributions Are Required Or Permitted.

references.excerpt: No Participant Contributions Are Required Or Permitted Under This Plan.

items.item_text: If the plan has Mandatory Employee Contributions (EEC), How the plan defines its Interest?
items.answer: N/A

items.item_text: If the plan has Mandatory Employee Contributions (EEC), What provisions are in place  If EEC Withdrawn?
items.answer: N/A

items.item_text: What are the Voluntary Provisions defined in the plan, if any?
items.answer: N/A

items.item_text: Was the plan Top-Heavy?
items.answer: Top-Heavy Status Applies If Key Employee Single Sum Benefits Exceed 60% Of All Participants' Single Sum Benefits As Of Determination Date.

references.excerpt: This Plan Will Be A Top-Heavy Plan... Single Sum Benefits Of All Key Employees Exceed 60%.

items.item_text: Top-Heavy Minimum Benefit applies to key employees in addition to non-key employees?
items.answer: No; Top-Heavy Minimum Benefit Applies To Non-Key Employees.

references.excerpt: For Any Plan Year In Which This Plan Is Determined To Be Top-Heavy, A Participant Who Is A Non-Key Employee... Will Be Entitled.

items.item_text: How plan defines Top-Heavy Service?
items.answer: Years Of Benefit Service Performed While Actually Participating In A Top-Heavy Plan Year Count For The Minimum Benefit.

references.excerpt: 2% For Each Year Of Benefit Service Performed While Actually Participating In The Plan During A Plan Year In Which The Plan Is Determined To Be Top-Heavy.

items.item_text: How plan defines Top-Heavy Average Compensation?
items.answer: Average Monthly Compensation Is The Average Rate Of Aggregate Compensation During The 5 Consecutive Years With Highest Aggregate Compensation.

references.excerpt: Average Monthly Compensation... Average Rate Of Aggregate Compensation During The 5 Consecutive Years... Highest Aggregate Compensation.

items.item_text: How plan defines Top-Heavy Minimum Benefit Formula?
items.answer: Monthly Straight Life Minimum Equals Average Monthly Compensation Times Lesser Of 2% Per Top-Heavy Year Of Benefit Service Or 20%.

references.excerpt: Monthly Benefit... Equal To The Product Of The Participant's Average Monthly Compensation Multiplied By The Lesser Of (1) 2% For Each Year... Or (2) 20%.

items.item_text: How plan defines Top-Heavy Vesting?
items.answer: Top-Heavy Vesting Schedule: Less Than 2 Years 0%; 2 20%; 3 40%; 4 60%; 5 80%; 6 Or More 100%.

references.excerpt: Top-Heavy Plan... Less Than 2 Years 0%, 2 Years 20%, 3 Years 40%, 4 Years 60%, 5 Years 80%, 6 Years Or More 100%.

items.item_text: How plan defines Default Actuarial Equivalence?
items.answer: 8% Interest Compounded Annually And UP-1984 Mortality; Lump Sums Use PBGC Rate Before July 1, 1997 And §417(e) Applicable Interest And Mortality After July 1, 1997.

references.excerpt: Interest: 8% Per Annum, Compounded Annually; Mortality: UP-1984 Mortality Table.

items.item_text: How plan defines Consensual Lump Sum Provisions?
items.answer: Immediate Lump Sum Option Available As An Optional Benefit Form Equal To Actuarial Equivalent Of Vested Accrued Benefit, Subject To Consent Rules.

references.excerpt: Lump Sum Option - An Immediate Single Sum Payment Equal To The Actuarial Equivalent Of The Participant's Vested Accrued Benefit.

items.item_text: Are there any Additional Provisions of Note?
items.answer: Benefits May Not Commence Later Than The 60th Day After The Close Of The Plan Year Containing Latest Of Age 65, Termination, Or 10th Anniversary Of Participation.

references.excerpt: Commencement... Not Later Than The 60th Day After The Close Of The Plan Year In Which Occurs The Latest Of...

items.item_text: What are the Names Of Majority Owners, if any?
items.answer: N/A
